name: return_duct_simplified
title: Simplified return duct model
summary: Curve fit of a return duct: the pressure drop and the mass, temperature and humidity effectiveness are power laws of the exit mass flow. With no condensation the humidity effectiveness equals the mass effectiveness.

origin.course: ULiège model bank, simplified return duct model, 2008-03-17

verification.notes: 25 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 0. CoolSolve, started from the stored values, stops at a maximum equation residual of 3.0000e-10. At rtol=0 the tool also flags p_ex_duct at 3.25e-11 (stored 99936.81119; 100000-63.18881325=99936.81118675), epsilon\epsilon_t_duct_n at 2.42e-13, epsilon\epsilon_M_duct_n at 3.67e-14 and DELTAp\DELTAp_duct_n at 2.53e-14. Without .initials it takes 14 iterations and converges on the other root of abs: M_dot_leakage_duct = +0.07966738751 kg/s (compare_solution.py: 25 common variables, 2 differ (rtol=0.001), M_dot_leakage_duct rel 2.00e+00 and M_dot_su_duct rel 2.75e-01). Pressure falls along the duct; t_ex_duct and W_ex_duct lie between the supply and environment values. Diagram-window inputs were restored as equations; no curve-fit equation was replaced.
